research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Security risk remediation tool focuses on protecting web applications by generating scan results through a server web browser that follows a behavior pattern simulating real user access to a web service. By executing this scan and observing how the web service responds, it identifies and supports remediation of security risks in client side interactions. Overall, Feroot Security is researching and developing automated web service scanning and security risk remediation.

product.description: Privacy and consent compliance software for websites and mobile apps that discovers data-processing scripts, audits consent and cookies, enforces privacy policies, and supports more than 50 regulations.

product.name: DXSecure
product.description: Browser- and mobile-layer security software that monitors scripts and data flows in real time and blocks malicious activity such as skimming, formjacking, script injection, and unauthorized data exfiltration.

product.description: PCI DSS 4.0.1 compliance and protection software for payment pages that inventories and authorizes scripts, detects tampering, blocks cardholder-data exfiltration, and produces audit evidence.
